description: Ramayana correspondences in the Hindi mythological film 'Bajrangbali' (1976, dir./prod. Chandrakant, Dara Singh as Hanuman; 170 min; music Kalyanji-Anandji, lyrics Kavi Pradeep). SCAFFOLD: entries are derived from the film's documented cast credits and IMDb synopsis, mapped to the Gita-Press spine. Every entry awaits a view/caption pass (Hindi auto-captions via yt-dlp, then timestamp anchoring) before locator and confidence can firm up.

target.numbering_notes: kanda/sarga in the Gita Press 1970s reprint numbering (= ramayana.info numbering); GP scans are the bindery archive.

entries.episode: Hanuman's birth and childhood: son of Anjani (Durga Khote) and Kesari, with Vayu as spiritual father; child Hanuman's leap at the rising sun and the Indra-vajra jaw wound.
entries.notes: Film evidence: cast credit Durga Khote as 'Devi Maa Anjani'; IMDb 'Vanar family tale: Pawan and Anjani's son'. The leap at the sun IS Valmiki (Uttara 34-36); the swallowing-the-sun variant is later vernacular — the film follows the vernacular telling per genre convention. Birth-of-Hanuman content absent from Valmiki's first six kandas; hence uttara anchor.

entries.episode: Shabari's hermitage: the aged ascetic woman (Dulari) receives Rama and offers tasted fruit.
entries.notes: Film evidence: cast credit Dulari as Shabari. The tasted-fruit detail beloved of the film tradition is aranya 74-78 (GP numbering; content-check pending).

entries.episode: Hanuman's tail set on fire by Ravana's guards (Moolchand credited as 'Ravan's guard, setting Bajrangbali's tail on fire'), followed by Hanuman burning Lanka.

refs.verified_against: ramayana.info sundara/53,54 (tail set fire to it; burning mansions)

entries.notes: Film evidence: explicit cast credit. Ramayana anchor content-verified; in GP numbering the tail-fire + burning of the city fall in sundara 53-54.

entries.episode: Kumbhakarna (Asit Sen) awakened, rampages, and falls to Rama.
entries.notes: Film evidence: cast credit Asit Sen as Kumbhakarna. Slain in GP yuddha 67-71 (content-check pending).

entries.episode: Meghnath/Indrajit (Randhawa) in battle with the serpentine noose and astras; his queen Sulochana (Jayshree Gadkar); Indrajit slain by Lakshmana.
entries.notes: Film evidence: cast credits Randhawa as 'Rajkumar Meghnath', Jayshree Gadkar as 'Rajkumari Sulochana'. The nagapasha binding is GP yuddha 47-49; the slaying is 87-90 (verified). Sulochana and the widow's grief thread are NOT in Valmiki — vernacular (Rama-charit-manas and later) material; her scenes are the film's own interpolation beyond Valmiki though Indrajit himself is Valmiki's, hence beyond_valmiki=false for the entry with the Sulochana caveat here.

entries.episode: Ravana mortally wounds Lakshmana; Hanuman lifts the whole Sanjivani mountain (IMDb: 'brings forth the Sanjeevani herb, along with the entire mountain, and Laxman gets a second life').
entries.notes: Film evidence: IMDb plot outline. Valmiki has the wound (Indrajit's shakti/brahmastra) and the mountain brought whole (GP yuddha 73-76); the film's dramatic emphasis on Hanuman carrying the mountain matches the tradition. Content-check pending.

entries.episode: Ravana's fall with Vibhishana's help (IMDb: 'Ten-headed Ravan is killed with Vibhisan's [Ravana's brother's]...'), then — per cast — the Uttara-kanda coda: the dhobi's quarrel (Ram Mohan), Sita's banishment, and the Lava-Kusha boys (Ajay, Master Alankar) with the asvamedha horse.
entries.notes: Film evidence: IMDb outline + cast credits Ram Mohan as 'Dhobi, washerman', Ajay as Luv, Master Alankar as Kush. The dhobi slander and Sita's banishment = GP uttara 42-48 (the HOL-259 fascicle's own sargas; numbering verified there); the Lava-Kusha asvamedha recitation and battle sit in the uttara tail (GP numbering for those sargas pending a check — 'various'). Vibhishana's counsel is Valmiki (yuddha 6-19); the slaying is 98-107 (106 verified).
